Provenance: the user supplied the GLSL text on 2026-10-28 and explicitly selected
it as TankForge's water reference. No original online shader URL/title was
provided or independently established. Exact supplied source is retained in
frank-hugenroth-water-reference.glsl (9794 bytes), SHA-256:
14804fe126af4f1e5ce3881611d5bca15c847bfcdf3cc6ed7db81e9f37c42261

TankForge R8.6 adaptation (2026-10-28):
- Reuse the five crossing swell components, four fBm scales, seven choppy-noise
  scales, reflected-ray weighting, and broad/narrow sun reflection lobes.
- Replace the missing iChannel0 noise image with the game's deterministic hash
  lattice, evaluate analytic gradients, filter each unresolved screen-space
  scale, smooth the abs cusp and bound the final normal slope.
- Reuse the game's sky, cloud/shadow field, exposure and shoreline alpha; add
  no texture/sampler, render target, camera, raymarcher or volumetric clouds.
- Preserve the registered water geometry, heights, collision and physics.

The adapted water GLSL and corresponding CPU reference in
handoff/tools/patch_r86_water.mjs carry this attribution and CC BY-NC-SA notice.
Retain this notice, its license link, and the source attribution with copies.
